_comment: Editorial content for the published matrix. Kept out of tools/artifact_matrix.py so a CI run never needs a source edit to say how a run is framed, and so the page's words can be reviewed as prose rather than as Python.
title: VISA Conformance Matrix
lede: Spec-cited conformance checks over HiSLIP and VXI-11, run from one container against one fault-injecting mock server. Rows where the implementations disagree carry colour. Click any row with a caret for the full failure or skip detail.
footer: Skips are counted and coloured separately from passes throughout. A skipped check reads like a passing one at a glance, and the ones that matter are those that stay skipped run after run — so every skip carries its reason.
